notes:
CHANDRA DYNASTY (sa-03-e). 2 pages opened (the budget for a 3-shape state); both are thin on dates.

What Cliopatria's row is: 'Chandra Dynasty' 900-1055 (77,000 km2, lon 91.3-94.9E, lat 17.9-24.1N: Arakan, Chittagong and the Tripura side). The Wikipedia page 'Chandra dynasty' covers two lines under one infobox (established 370, disestablished 1050): the early Chandras of Arakan (Dhvenchandra, 'Dhanyawadi and Waithali', Anandachandra) and the Chandras of Harikela and Samatata from Trailokyachandra (900-930) and Srichandra (c. 930-975) with their centre at Bikrampur in Vanga. Cliopatria's 900 start matches Trailokyachandra; this dossier is the Harikela line, 900-1050. Whether the Arakan line is a separate state (and whether the Cliopatria shape's Arakan part belongs to it) is page-silent: a gap-filler should open 'Waithali', 'Arakan' and 'Samatata'.

Not settled: who held Vanga and Sylhet before the Chandras (the ledger names pala-empire and kamarupa-kingdom as flagged guesses at confidence 1); the end (1050 infobox; Pala annexation vs the Harikela page's Varmans; Cliopatria 1055); the Chola Tirumulai inscription naming the Chandra kings 'kings of Vangaladesha' (undated on the page). No infobox area exists, so no area sanity check.
Counterparts needing dossiers: harikela-kingdom (Chittagong coast before 900), varman-dynasty-of-east-bengal (already a slug in the pala-empire dossier), and an Arakan state (the pagan-kingdom dossier uses the slug 'arakan').
Gazetteer names needed: Samatata, Harikela, Vanga/Bikrampur (the regions Sylhet (region) and the places Comilla, Chattogram, Dhaka exist).

FIX ROUND (2026-10-19, after the reviewer's 'fail'). Applied: (1) the 947 and 1046 shapes now add Bikrampur (Dhaka 40 km) and Sylhet (region), and the dissolve region and the pala-empire successor land use the same union on the 1046 shape; I also add Samatata (Comilla 70 km) to all of them because Cliopatria's shapes never reach it (Comilla 70 km minus the 900 or 947 shape = 10,100 km2) while the found event and the page ('ruled the Samatata area of Bengal') name it for the whole life; this goes one step beyond the reviewer's union for 947 and 1046 and follows from the reviewer's own finding 2. (2) chandra-dynasty_900 is now the shape plus Comilla, valid 900-929, and the new chandra-dynasty_930 (930-946) adds Bikrampur and Sylhet. (3) The Harikela-line ruler list is now given (page table, five rulers 900-1050; the ruler list this dossier lacked was a gap the reviewer named). (4) The Chola Ganges expedition 1019-1022 (Govindachandra defeated) is now a war here, from the Rajendra Chola I page; the Chandra page itself does not mention Rajendra. No disagreement with the reviewer.
Still open (gaps for a gap-filler): who held Vanga and Sylhet before c. 930 (Samatata page), the end of the dynasty (Pala annexation on the Chandra page vs the Varmans on the Harikela page, 1050 vs Cliopatria's 1055: Varman_dynasty_(Bengal) page), and the Arakan line.
